name: Katie Petit
why: Her candidate photograph at the head of her own profile in the Herald election guide, set directly under the display headline naming her; candidates with no picture carry a Photo not available box in that slot. The Herald spells the surname Pettit throughout and the archive spells it Petit, which the archive itself flags as a spelling doubt (the minutes print Penit three times); the Herald has her a WKU freshman senator in spring 2004 and still an SGA senator entering a third year in autumn 2005, which matches this person and no other.

name: Dajana Vasilijevic-Klingler
why: Studio headshot from the Phi Mu Delta Tau chapter composite for 2006-2007, her name printed on the plate directly beneath her own oval. The archive holds her under the later married form Vasilijevic-Klingler and notes no independent source had been found for the spelling; this plate is that source, and the name is unique on campus.

name: Theodore Harden
why: Herald portrait made for its SGA presidential candidate profiles, his name set in display type directly beneath the frame. Smiling, well lit, front on; small only because the printed frame is 282px in the scan. The archive files him as Theodore Harden and the Herald headline reads TEDDE HARDEN: the same issue carries his campaign letter on p. 4A signed Theodore Harden, presidential candidate, with the address theodore.harden@wku.edu, and the profile gives his SGA service as academic affairs committee 2006-2007, which is the archive entry.
